Samagra Shiksha Diu Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Samagra Shiksha Diu Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Samagra Shiksha Diu PGT posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) posts at Samagra Shiksha Diu is scheduled for 10 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the PGT posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in the respective subject with at least 50% marks and a B.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institution, or a Post Graduate degree with at least 50% marks and a B.A.Ed./B.Sc.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the PGT positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all PGT posts is 30 years. Age relaxation may be provided as per the prevailing Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the PGT posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 29000 per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the PGT posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) positions, with one vacancy each for Accountancy, History, Geography, Statistics, and Business Studies.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Samagra Shiksha Diu PGT recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) posts through this walk-in recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these PGT positions?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the PGT posts will involve a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Which subjects are covered under the PGT recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment covers PGT positions for Accountancy, History, Geography, Statistics, and Business Studies.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for these PGT posts?
faq.answer: The job location is Diu, within the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.
